title: Happy Mother Holding Laughing Baby, 1950s Deckle Edge B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A heartwarming mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a joyful mother smiling down at her laughing infant seated on her lap. The mother is dressed in a casual patterned day dress typical of the post-WWII baby boom era, while the baby wears a light-colored smock and knit booties. They sit outdoors alongside a brick residential house under tree shade, printed with decorative scalloped (deckled) borders on Velox paper.
